title: RMOND / Relativistic MOND (Skordis & Zlosnik)
efc_relevance: New RMOND action reproduces CMB acoustic peaks, BAO, and rotation curves in a single relativistic theory. Stronger competitor than TeVeS — must be compared against EFC on CMB, BAO, AND SPARC simultaneously. Discriminator: RMOND introduces two extra fields (Aμ, φ) with specific coupling; EFC uses one scalar (S) derived from entropic-flow constraint.
ledger_action: Logged as primary 2021+ relativistic-MOND competitor. Required benchmark in any EFC multi-probe comparison table.
